note: Data (not code) for scripts/generate-bridge-allowlist.mjs. Transcribed from the heads platform spec of record, docs/specs/heads/01-lease-and-bridge.md §5.2-§5.3 (mixpanel-desktop-app). Everything here is an explicit table: the generator does no fuzzy matching and fails hard on anything these tables do not cover.

pathPlaceholders.note: How a path segment becomes a placeholder (spec 01 §5.3 step 2), in this order: session project_id -> {project_id}; a value carried under a closedEnumKey -> LITERAL, because the api's parameter is a fixed set of route names and a placeholder there would wildcard the family; a value carried under a keyedPlaceholder key (or that placeholder's sessionField) -> that named placeholder, so §5.5 has something to pin; any other call.input value -> {param}; an all-digit leftover -> {int}; everything else literal. Keyed lookups read call.setup[*].input as well as call.input, because the client learns its workspace from a setup call (api_client.set_workspace_id) rather than from the measured call's own arguments — in the pinned corpus that setup form is the ONLY thing that resolves a workspace id; the `sessionField` and direct call.input forms below currently match nothing and are kept because a corpus refresh may start carrying them.

pinRules.note: Which identifier spec 01 §5.5 can hold a route to. §5.5 pins EVERY occurrence of a project identifier, and the query family carries its project id as a query param or a top-level JSON body field rather than as a path segment — so evidence is taken from all three places, not just the template. `kinds` is in precedence order (first with any evidence wins) and each row also records `pinSources`, the places that identifier actually appears, so the handler knows what to check. A workspace-scoped route pins to its project when it carries project evidence and to the workspace otherwise; it is never pin-less, and the generator fails if one ever is. Only a route with no bindable identifier at all — the account-level reads GET /api/app/me and GET /api/app/projects/metadata/index — is pin "none".

consent.note: Spec 01 §7.2. `countPlaceholder` is filled by the desktop's consent composer from the request body's `ids` array length; the generator only validates that it appears solely on bulk methods, identified by the prefix/suffix below.

deniedRoutes.reason: Mints a signed off-host PUT URL. Handing that to a page would create an unbounded upload capability outside the regional host set and outside the allowlist, and the lookup_tables write class is not grantable to page principals in v1. The route stays visible here, out of `rows`, so the handler can name what it refused instead of failing as an unknown route.

excludedApis.api_client.app_request: Generic escape hatch (arbitrary method+path); recorded paths are a mix of real routes and test literals; every real route it hits is covered by its own method's row. Spec 01 §5.3 step 1 excludes it by name.
excludedApis.api_client.request: Generic escape hatch (arbitrary method+path); recorded paths are a mix of real routes and test literals; every real route it hits is covered by its own method's row.
excludedApis.pagination.paginate_all: Generic paginator over a caller-supplied path; 73 of its 82 recorded interactions use the synthetic test path /api/app/projects/12345/items. The real routes it walks are covered by the apis that own them (e.g. api_client.list_dashboards).
excludedApis.api_client.export_events: Export family. Its only host is https://data.mixpanel.com, which spec 01 §5.2 never admits — the bridge refuses export before the network.
excludedApis.replays.fetch_files: Session-replay CDN walk (https://cdn.test in the corpus). Admitted at runtime through a response-derived grant minted from a sign_replays 200 (spec 01 §5.4), never through a route template.
excludedApis.api_client.upload_to_signed_url: PUT to a signed object-store URL (storage.googleapis.com / storage.example.com). Outside the regional host set entirely; the same derived-grant pattern as fetch_files applies, not the allowlist.
excludedApis.oauth_flow.refresh_tokens: Auth plane: POST /oauth/token/, not /api/query/ or /api/app/, so spec 01 §5.2 rejects the path. Main owns the token and refreshes it itself (§5.6); the page never performs this call.
excludedApis.region_probe.probe_region: Auth plane: runs before a lease exists, and is recorded only against the base_url override host https://test.invalid. Its real route, GET /api/app/me, is in the table via api_client.resolve_workspace_id.
excludedApis.api_client.resolve_short_link: GET /s/<code> — outside the /api/query/ and /api/app/ path space spec 01 §5.2 admits.

coverageExceptions.api_client.maybe_scoped_path: No wire vector in the pinned corpus. It is the non-raising sibling of api_client.require_scoped_path (returns null instead of raising when the project has no workspace) and resolves the same route, GET /api/app/projects/{project_id}/workspaces/public, which require_scoped_path already puts in the table.
coverageExceptions.workspace.me: No wire vector in the pinned corpus. It is the Workspace facade over GET /api/app/me, which api_client.resolve_workspace_id already puts in the table.

access.note: Classification is by the PYTHON method name (the segment after the last dot), never the HTTP verb — spec 01 §5.3 step 4. readPrefixes/writePrefixes are transcribed from the spec; readMethods/writeMethods are exact-name rows for corpus apis no spec prefix reaches. A name matching both a read and a write rule is a generator error, as is a name matching neither.

readMethods.arb_funnels_query: POST /api/query/arb_funnels — an ad-hoc funnel query; reads only.
readMethods.bookmark_linked_dashboard_ids: GET of the dashboards a saved report is on.
readMethods.engage_stats: POST /api/query/engage/stats — a profile-count query; reads only.
readMethods.export_lexicon: GET /api/app/.../data-definitions/export/ — downloads the Lexicon; unrelated to the export event host.
readMethods.export_profiles: POST /api/query/engage/ — pages profiles off the Engage query host; reads only.
readMethods.export_profiles_page: One page of the same Engage profile read.
readMethods.insights_query: POST /api/query/insights — an ad-hoc Insights query; reads only.
readMethods.require_scoped_path: GET of the project's public workspace, to build a workspace-scoped path.
readMethods.resolve_workspace: GET of the project's public workspace.

writeMethods.register_lookup_table: POST /api/app/.../data-definitions/lookup-tables/ — creates the lookup-table record after an upload.

writeClasses.note: First match wins over the route template, so the specific rows come before the general ones. Classes are spec 01 §5.3 step 5; the `contains` strings are the shapes the corpus actually records (the App API mixes hyphens and underscores).
